title: Locator completeness: ledger-derived page gate for records and field-level provenance (continuations, container capacity, spell lists)
description:
SCOPE (registry rows locator-completeness indep:008, container-continuation fable:F4, source-provenance-fields sol:CAP-010; plan B2 "include all 23 adjacent-page locator gaps and container-capacity page 70; include spell-list pages and class primary-ability source pages at field level").
The audit's "23" is a 07-24 snapshot, not acceptance. Live derivation (c53ba040): for every source-region-ledger entry classified record:<key>, the pages pageStart..pageEnd not cited by that record's `source`/provenance.locator. Current result = 11 records:
 rule:class-features (p.57; regions on 8,11,15,19,24,26,30,35,39,42,46,52 - likely a MIS-ATTRIBUTION of per-class "Class Features" headings, investigate before extending the locator), feature:druid:wild-shape (+21), feature:sorcerer:font-of-magic (+44), feature:draconic-bloodline:dragon-ancestor (+45), equipment:crystal (+67), spell:scrying (+177), magic-item:deck-of-many-things (+218), magic-item:figurine-of-wondrous-power (+223), magic-item:manual-of-golems (+230), rule:hit-points (+256), rule:half-dragon-template (+321).
Field level: Container Capacity rows (table p.69-70) attach `capacity` to gear records; the field must cite the page its row is printed on. Spell-list membership (spell.data.classes) and class primary-ability fields must cite their source pages in field-provenance.json.
Required invariant (gate, fail-closed in verify:dnd5e-srd-pack): record locator pages ⊇ pages of every ledger region owned by the record; structured field provenance cites the page of its source row/span. Denominator = region ledger (source-derived). A mismatch caused by wrong ownership must be fixed at ownership, never by widening the locator (see recordSourceAnchors.ts header).
